title: White House registers aliens.gov

tellings.quote:
know if you saw this, but uh the White
House just registered aliens.gov, gov,

plain: According to Michels, the White House recently registered the web address aliens.gov. He raises it himself, without naming a source, while speaking with a former director of the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that intercepts communications. He offers it as a hint that the government may be getting ready to speak publicly about aliens.
